**PotentialHeat 1.0.0**, the first release.

A soft clipper and bus saturator for your MPC: warmth, glue and loudness without clipping. Three characters (soft, tape, hard), tone, ceiling, level match and 12 one-tap presets. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialheat#readme) for everything it does and its limitations.

**Download** `PotentialHeat-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialheat/issues/new/choose).
